title: Vegan Ackee Stir Fry
description: A delicious and easy vegan stir fry made with ackee, a variety of crunchy vegetables, and a hint of floral spice.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and carrots, cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the bell peppers and cook until they are tender, about 3 minutes.
Stir in the floral spice and cook for 1 minute.
Add the ackee and vegan stir fry sauce, stir-fry until the ackee is heated through.
Add the crunchy vegetable stir fry mix and stir-fry until combined.

Note: Traditional ackee stir fry recipes call for ackee cooked in its own juices, but since ackee is a fruit it can be cooked in a variety of ways. This recipe uses a quick and easy stir-fry method to cook the ackee with other vegetables.
Cooking temperature: medium-high heat (400°F) to prevent overcooking the ackee.
